exposure: Nulliparous women in private maternity hospitals
Nulliparous women in public maternity hospitals
cohort: 29,870 nulliparous women giving birth in public maternity hospitals in Ireland
finding: While the private model of care was associated with higher ELCS and EMCS rates, this difference was insignificant for EMCS after adjusting for maternal, clinical, and hospital characteristics.
mod_finding: The private model of care was associated with higher rates of both elective and emergency cesarean sections compared to the public model, although this difference was insignificant for emergency cesareans after adjusting for maternal characteristics.
